views.task_interaction: 发现实际能力/来源 -> 准备/观察/有限控制 -> 固定报告修订 -> 真实文件选择及Task -> 同源四格式
views.structure_data: H09 request/catalog/history selectors, ExecutionReport and compact ExportExecutionReportResult
views.state_behavior: Task成功、业务目标、云同步、导出完成独立；未知响应查原请求，不重投生产
views.interface_collaboration: actual caller capabilities plus canonical generated schemas; ordinary Agent excludes H04-H07; H10 export and C18 history
views.ui_presentation: 云端执行页增加来源/报告操作，保留旧Run交付工作区，不新增完整工作区
views.deployment_verification: 复用真实MCP/文件选择/字体/导出发布；本轮没有产品代码、连接客户端或导出实际文件

agent.catalog: existing Host capabilities already filters actual caller.allowed_operations; add role-specific gateway rejection and exact resource/action scope; MCP lists only actual producer-approved operations
agent.gateway_role: trusted Native registration only; ordinary external-session update cannot turn ExternalAgent into Gateway or UI; request JSON never carries authority
agent.mcp_task_semantics: product TaskHandle/get_task remain existing tool result protocol; do not claim MCP native tasks capability
agent.hint_basis: H08 is business-read-only but registers a real Task; hints describe effects, never supply authorization or require an extra approval gate
workflow: read actual get_context host/project identity, capabilities and grant; keep existing build/Run workflow separate
H09 catalog discovers actual local saved/current executions; list is discovery, every action pins exact source
start H01 once with remembered canonical request_id; observe same Task, scope/kind/input_revision/originating operation/request id
read H02/H09 same identity/revision; H08 explicitly selects cloud, including fixed R/F history; do not recompute acceptance
execute only explicitly authorized finite H03 actions with expected_execution_revision; reconcile conflicts via read
observation budget expiration returns pending/needs-resolution observation status; no automatic production cancellation, new epoch or failed-goal claim

resolve current/cutoff selection to exact R; obtain actual selected directory purpose export_execution_report; H10 creates export Task; if prediction requested, select actual Project Run via get_context/get_run, require terminal status, remember RunId/input reference and explicit execution target; H10 receipt prediction link must match
export completed means selected files committed; production success requires actual snapshot goal and obligations

data_query_consumer.entry: H08(data_query), finite L56 execution_workflow.py; do not reuse current infinite wait_task as bounded consumer
data_query_consumer.task: actual operation/request/scope/kind and Task output first; completed cloud_read is one page, not query completion
data_query_consumer.selection: telemetry pins cloud project/dataset/query and first selected_visible_frontier; same filter/page size and original cursor later; execution keeps original identity/revision semantics; telemetry also pins actual selected_device_ids; aggregation start null means before row0
data_query_consumer.typed_rows: request aggregation determines accepted row kind; preserve data_quality_issues and source; generic union shape alone does not prove request/response correlation
data_query_consumer.budget: explicit page/time observation budget; stop with observed pages/rows, dataset/F and incomplete coverage plus pending cursor; do not claim full count or cancel production
data_query_consumer.large_data: million-row correctness/60 query timing belongs to tools/cloud verify_daas.py; not million rows accumulated in model context; complete minute aggregate may be summarized only after all group pages actually read
data_query_consumer.local_summary: consumer-local page/coverage summary only; no new Host operation/schema root/capability or fake runtime proof

agent.prediction_selection: get_context实际RunSummary目录发现，get_run summary核对Run/输入/终态；需要完整原结果时沿既有managed桥读取，不把整个RunResult作为H10参数或让模型复算比较。H10从Host实际归档取完整原结果。
agent.data_export: H11需要真实purpose目录及固定query/selection；有限观察原Task，不把million行拉入模型；get_task completed+cloud_data_export+原请求/选源及2文件才认文件完成；取消不停止生产

request_recovery.registration: Task and original request index are inserted atomically before I/O
request_recovery.same_identity: same typed operation/params returns original Task; different params InvalidInput at request_id, original work preserved
request_recovery.lookup: H09 request -> ExecutionRequestStatus; requires existing owned_task/actual scope authority, no file token or params export
request_recovery.new_task_state: originating_request_id optional on legacy TaskState, required populated postcondition for new H01/H08/H10/H11 states
request_recovery.not_found: not evidence original network call cannot arrive; no automatic resubmission
request_recovery.restart: index is current Host context only; changed context stops this workflow and invokes existing old-epoch reconciliation, no cross-restart exactly-once claim

report.producer: H10 export_execution_report, actual frozen sources only; no caller-supplied report or accepted quantity
report.sources: 1 or2 distinct execution identities, exact host/cloud revision references in one authorized Project; reject duplicate session/epoch sources, pins must agree; optional explicit prediction link points one selected execution source plus actual terminal Project Run; null is execution-only, never silently omit invalid selected prediction
report.history: H09 local history or H08/C18 cloud history through exact F, full required prefix; missing records are errors, not resimulation
report.canonical: ExecutionReport shared by all four output formats; legacy EvaluationReport/RunEvaluation keep Run semantics; prediction_comparison is same canonical field across formats, distinct from execution-execution comparison
files: csv/<table>.csv plus required existing font/license resources
report.compact_receipt: ExportExecutionReportResult returns actual FileRefs/source stamps, not full report body repeated inside get_task
report.destination: new FilePurpose.ExportExecutionReport and strict SelectedFileRef purpose; no arbitrary path or borrowed selection
report.task: LongTaskKind.Exporting, TaskOutput.ExecutionReport; cancel export only, file publication follows existing atomic method
report.images: new execution report is the canonical data/source/metric delta; existing Run report images and output remain available; never attach old Run image as execution proof
report.current_scope: fixed single-operation software-in-loop demo; old professional/cost report remains unchanged; T8-A07 prediction Run selection and deviation design retained
report.asset_rights: module_ref-qualified AssetRights; do not merge same asset id from different frozen modules
report.daas_boundary: ExecutionReport来自固定执行snapshot/history；selected_visible_frontier是dataset ingress前沿，报告observation_frontier是Host状态记录前沿，两者不能互换。generated/telemetry计数和Q03结果不填入执行接受量或四格式生产结论；四格式使用同一canonical对象不因此新增数据分析报告。

prediction_execution_gap.requirement_ref: docs/01_业务需求/任务8_应用形态功能需求与实现缺口.md; T8-A07/F06/F16; continuous flow step8
prediction_execution_gap.previous_gap: 当前H10来源仅1或2个execution identity；ExecutionReport无本地Run来源，execution-execution比较不能覆盖预测Run与云执行比较
prediction_execution_gap.resolution: draft9在H10新增显式PredictionExecutionLink、canonical prediction_comparison及回执link；真实终态Run、输入内容和分指标比较规则见V2-PREDICTION-REPORT-11

report.prediction_waiting: 模型对象的实际WaitInterval按原metrics::waiting对象关联、区间裁剪/并集；与执行逻辑工作的Host等待分列，必须核对对象/等待定义/覆盖范围才可比较，不用虚拟等待冒充Host或物理等待。

metrics.name: accepted by scope
metrics.source: frozen acceptance scopes + actual acceptance_events/order outcomes
metrics.rule: exact decimal and unit; preserve old ambiguous overlapping-product scope limitation as unknown, not zero

metrics.name: target time
metrics.source: first unambiguous actual acceptance prefix meeting fixed target
metrics.rule: Host epoch ms; unknown if clock not started/target not proved; device Completed count is not target completion

metrics.name: command counts
metrics.rule: separate attempt, Started, device Completed, accepted logical work and unresolved counts; none substitute quantity

metrics.name: waiting
metrics.rule: integrate queued / reserved-published-device_accepted / output_wait / reconciliation_required separately over observed range; same-ms intervals zero duration

metrics.name: resource occupation
metrics.rule: union occupied duration and summed unit-ms clipped to observed frontier; physical effective work stays nullable and source-qualified

metrics.name: comparison
metrics.source: two frozen inputs, snapshots and recorded availability changes
metrics.rule: candidate minus baseline; completion delta needs equal fixed target/input/clock and proved goal+settlement; quantity delta additionally needs equal observed cutoff coverage; signed magnitude for quantities

csv.nulls: empty CSV numeric cells with known/missing-condition columns; JSON null remains null, PDF/HTML say unknown with reason
csv.nested_values: typed JSON cells, normal CSV quoting; do not stringify numbers through float or translate missing to zero

column_sources.candidate_details_json: latest_dispatch_decision.candidates or dispatch_decision.candidates; null when absent
column_sources.target_device_boot_id: attempt.target_device_boot_id for attempt rows; null for logical_work rows (current attempt resolved through matching attempt row)

column_sources.view_boundary: outer view_boundary when open, actual_release for closed intervals

csv.mapping_rule: unmapped column takes same-named property from its declared row source; mixed row_kind absent fields are null; computed/renamed sources are explicit below
csv.header_rule: start with report/session prefix for the row scope, then append declared columns not already present; identical source-context fields emitted once; admission/record revisions remain renamed
csv.global_issues: global Issue rows leave session/epoch/R/F columns empty and retain exact source_path; do not invent a session
csv.prediction_prefix_rule: new prediction tables use actual Run/target execution keys; original session_row_prefix applies only existing execution-specific tables

source_anchors.purpose: Task/register/dispatch header/caller-filtered capabilities and owned task discovery
ordinary external authority cannot become trusted gateway
actual canonical schemas, effect hints and actual operation listing
managed response/schema/context correlation must include new generated operations
keep old Run workflow; new execution finite consumer separate
existing task context/file purpose/formats/task output and Run-bound export
actual file-publish/selected destination precedent; preserve Run producer
legacy report/RunEvaluation cannot carry an external snapshot by relabeling
reuse exact arithmetic/intervals only; preserve Run validation
actual four-format byte production and common table projection
share necessary lower-level PDF primitives/fonts without fake EvaluationReport
preserve old Run reporting UI and result type
source/task/result matching and actual selected-file output

design_cases.trigger: 普通Agent读取catalog并伪造网关操作
design_cases.expected: catalog不发布H04-H07；实际Host仍拒绝，角色不由请求注入

design_cases.trigger: H08读取原始/分钟聚合数据并返回异种行或后续页
design_cases.expected: 核对原Task/请求和数据dataset/F/aggregation行型；Task成功只代表本页，MCP提示不授予控制，非完整不声称全量
同Host按原请求查询原Task，不新建生产会话
明确冲突，保留原Task和工作
保持未知并核对旧epoch；不据此重新生产
仍固定R/F/range及原序列，不拼接新前缀

design_cases.trigger: 生产或DaaS分页观察预算耗尽
design_cases.expected: 仅结束观察；DaaS保留原范围及实际页数并标未完整，不能用部分行推全量；不停止生产或伪填目标失败

design_cases.trigger: 导出选择目的/所有者不符
design_cases.expected: 拒绝写入；不接受任意路径或借用旧token
只取消生成/写入，生产会话不回滚
四格式执行与预测来源、数值/单位/未知原因一致；dataset ingress不能冒充状态前沿或接受量；T8-A07另按PE01..08验证实际Run来源/指标条件，未运行不填通过

design_cases.trigger: 接受事件存在重叠产品口径歧义
design_cases.expected: 对应数量未知并列原因，不合并为零或目标量

design_cases.trigger: 六条设备Completed但只接受五件
design_cases.expected: 命令计数与接受量分列，目标未完成

design_cases.trigger: 早结束或截止未到的报告
design_cases.expected: 覆盖实际前沿，不补满观察窗或改截止结论

design_cases.trigger: 同毫秒逻辑工作多次改变
design_cases.expected: 等待按真实有长度区间累计，不加1ms或重复计时
差值方向明确定义，数量不写入负SafeUint或错标改善
报告失败/缺证，不调用Engine重新计算补记录
旧API/含义及对应输出保持，执行报告不冒充Run
仍能从本机真实目录选择历史修订，控制权不随目录恢复

design_cases.trigger: 新操作返回托管大结果
design_cases.expected: 沿实际桥验证schema/请求/上下文及租约，不截断为成功或另发同一工作
不返回整套导出成功，不覆盖原已有效文件或污染生产状态

resource_projection_rule: ProjectedResourceClaim.open_interval_index identifies the one open interval or null; index bounds/actual boundary checked at publication. CSV is_open is derived per interval; view_boundary is an enum, not milliseconds
observation_freshness_consumer: snapshot.devices与typed device state_history保留原ObservationProbe及有效期；普通Agent/报告只读固定R/F/T，不生成probe或用云最后时间推断新鲜；H10不使过期样本变fresh
